title: Colocti Origin
description:
Adds a cactus-based origin

For a friend
body:
A mod that adds a cactus-based origin.
###### (Was made for a friend)

### Lore:
 *Colocti are distant cousins to the regular cactus. They developed intelligence and are able to alter their appearance, though there are few remaining today.*



### Powers:

\+ Prickly: Permanent thorns effect when armor is at or below 4.

\+ Cactus Inflation: You can grow to twice your size and deal more damage for 21 seconds.

\= Desertspawn: You spawn in a desert.

\= Cactus Shrink: You can shrink on-command to gain energy, but you'll lose some health. You can regrow by getting some sunlight.

\- Photosynthesis Dependency: You have a sunlight bar that allows you to eat more things as it drains, which refills when in sunlight and gives saturation when full.




### ***Requires Pehkui and Origins***
